Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the e-learning and have referral paperwork, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. Please bring referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor; the course includes four certification dives over two days. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands, and accommodation isn’t included.

The refresher is a one-day pool session and one ocean dive, with a same-day return to Cartagena. The exact total is shown during online checkout.

A refresher and a certified diver can join the same outing.

Please note: the refresher and referral course are separate activities, and the referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands.

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel rather than included in the dive plan.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.
